edges.description: Defective Sec-tRNA formation blocks the route to selenoprotein generation.
Loss of selenoprotein generation preferentially manifests as early-onset brain and cerebellar developmental-neurodegenerative disease.
Cerebellocerebral neurodegeneration produces progressive cerebellar atrophy on brain MRI.
Impaired cerebellar neurodevelopment manifests as pontocerebellar and cerebellar hypoplasia.
Cerebellocerebral neurodevelopmental injury leads to early-onset profound developmental delay.
Progressive cerebral and cerebellar atrophy results in progressive microcephaly.
Early cerebellocerebral injury causes infantile hypotonia that evolves toward spasticity.
The infantile hypotonia of SEPSECS deficiency develops toward severe spasticity.
The brain injury extends beyond the cerebellum, with progressive cerebellar atrophy followed by cerebral atrophy of white and gray matter on repeated MRI.
